why: A file with any statement before its first function line is a script whose functions are local to it: it runs by name and its functions are out of reach of other files (MATLAB Code Analyzer help: 'If any statements precede a function definition, MATLAB considers the file a script').

known.what: The statement `s1` in main.m does not link to the script s1.m (MATLAB runs it); its call stays a live row.
known.why: Accepted in step 2 (scripts) as conservative: a script with local functions (R2016b+) counts as no script.
